ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The stock public-interview demand for the central point of the buddhas' teaching.
EvidenceBody: Daolin answers Bai Juyi with 'do no evils; carry out the many goods'; Qingyuan Xingsi asks an unnamed monk the price of rice in Luling; Linji Yixuan shouts at one unnamed monk and raises the whisk before striking another; Zhaozhou Congshen tells an unnamed monk to pay his respects and then cuts off the attempted continuation. When Ding Shangzuo asks, Linji leaves the Chan seat, seizes Ding, slaps him, and pushes him away. Xuedou Chongxian answers another unnamed monk with 'five-colored auspicious clouds.' The repeated formula is one public demand, while its recorded replies range across maxim, counter-question, shout, implement, image, and bodily action. The records supply no single answer shared by all these exchanges.
